dct_title_s: AMERICA AVSTR.ALIS DEIPARÆ Multas Sacras Aedes erexit in quib'magnos ab Illa fauores accipit
dct_description_sm: Issued in: Atlas marianvs , Anno M.DCCII : Atlas Novus, Pars III; following [p.12]4. 7 parts (pars), Munich, published 1702-10; reissued 1730-37.
Shows southern part of California, labelled: "Ins. CALIFORNIA", internal mountains, and S. Bruno, S. Jago, and N.S. De Guadalupe.
Title cartouche of Native American kneeling before a vision of the Virgin and Child (top left).
4 bar scales on map, given in "Milliaria Germanica," "Milliaria Hispanica," "Milliaria Gallica," and "Milliaria Italica & Anglica."
UCB; J. Potter "Choicd Items From Stock-12", 1996, Item # 164..
